purpose: Representación publicable del cuerpo de una nota OPURO como Gutenberg nativo serializado. Es el valor de MASTER_JSON.GUTENBERG_ENRIQUECIDO_FINAL y el único cuerpo que el Publisher OPURO v1.3 envía a post_content.

media.hero_and_featured: HERO_OPURO and DESTACADA_OPURO remain native media operations of the Publisher and are not injected into post_content.
media.inline_image: Only emit core/image after a native attachment has been resolved. It must have a numeric wp-image-{id} class, HTTPS source URL and literal ALT. If no binding exists, omit the block; never invent an ID, URL, ALT or token.

compatibility.HTML_FINAL: Preserved for archive, review and compatibility; not used as OPURO post_content by Publisher v1.3.
compatibility.GUTENBERG_FINAL: Preserved as the portable OPOL body.
compatibility.GUTENBERG_ENRIQUECIDO_FINAL: Required OPURO body. It expresses the same substantive final text as TEXTO_EDITORIAL and the other outputs.

publisher_preflight: rejects forbidden structural markers and unresolved placeholders
rejects non-native or unapproved Gutenberg block names
rejects core/image without native attachment evidence
